_what: Owner decisions the weekly LLM security scan must remember. A finding whose file and vulnerability_type match an entry (case-insensitive regular expressions) is logged and skipped by the issue step, with the reason; it still appears in the uploaded report. Closing an issue in the UI is not a memory the next run can read - this file is. Owner-run CLI tools and vendored code are not listed here: they are excluded from the sweep itself in llm-security-scan.yml.
_how: Add an entry when a finding is a documented design decision, never for one that is merely inconvenient; name the document that carries the reasoning.

accepted.reason: SECURITY.md, 'Data at rest is not encrypted by the app': the Plex token and API keys must be usable by unattended background jobs; encrypting them would only move the key next to the data. Disk encryption is the operator's layer.

SECURITY.md, threat model: Curatarr serves one household over the LAN; TLS and access control belong to the operator's reverse proxy, not to the app. Plex, the *arr services and Ollama are reached by the URLs the owner configured.
